name: Jonathan
overview: Jonathan was a male member of the tribe of Levi, uniquely identified as the son of Abiathar the priest according to 2 Samuel 15:27. There are no additional notable personal details recorded about him in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Jonathan means "gift of YHWH," reflecting a theologically rich Hebrew meaning. This proper name, recorded in 2 Samuel 15:27, points to a recognition of divine blessing or favor.
familyAndRelationships: Jonathan is explicitly recorded as the son of Abiathar the priest, establishing his priestly lineage within the tribe of Levi. Scripture does not provide further family relationships for him beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jonathan's significance lies primarily in his priestly heritage as the son of Abiathar, situating him within the Levitical priesthood during the time of King David. Although less is known about his personal actions, his identity contributes to the broader understanding of the priestly families that served during David's reign.
